result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers pick forest green for the same sound reasons and lay out similar section-by-section guidance. B is stronger because it gives a full palette with hex values for the action color, neutrals, tint and footer, plus contrast ratios that it says are hand-calculated estimates; the white-on-green figure checks out. A gives only one hex value and leaves the accent and neutrals unspecified. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers pick forest green for good reasons tied to a local, member-owned institution, and both give similar section-by-section guidance. A is stronger because it gives a full palette with hex values for every role and contrast estimates that check out (white on #1F4D3A is about 9.6:1). It also limits marigold strictly to the Join button. B gives only the lead hex value and an unspecified gold or amber accent, so its guidance is harder to act on, though its 70/20/10 rule of thumb is a useful addition.
